name: Meeting Notes to Action Items
description: Reads meeting notes (input: notes_path, output_path), has the LLM extract action items, and saves them as a checklist. Shows tool steps (deterministic file I/O) combined with an LLM step.

task.instruction:
From the meeting notes below, list every action item as one markdown checklist line.
Use this style (the example is from a different meeting):
- [ ] Alex: send the budget draft to finance (due: Tuesday)
- [ ] Sam: book the venue (due: unspecified)
Rules: use the real person's name; describe the real task in a few words; give the due date from the notes or 'unspecified'. Only list things a person will do, not decisions or chatter. Output only the checklist.

Notes:
{{notes.content}}
